densityBasis: densityPer1000Households is an ESTIMATE = dwellingsEstimate (residential dwellings + use-unclassified buildings) per 1,000 households. The unclassified bucket is mostly, not certainly, dwellings. Strict residential and habitable-buildings counts are also stored so the figure can be recomputed on any basis.
note: Heritage designation is devolved. This dataset covers England (Historic England) and Wales (Cadw) only. Scottish listed buildings and conservation areas are held by Historic Environment Scotland and are not included.
